title: docs(skills): navigation.md states the derived record surface per flow — viewing routes to a page, create/edit opens a modal bounded on desktop and full-screen on mobile, a light record uses a drawer
body:
Fixes #23753
Clause-②: no

## What

`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md` L131–135 — the 「Surface (page vs drawer)」 bullet under Record Presentation — said a field-heavy object "opens create/edit/detail as a **full page**" and that "Mobile always pages". The platform derives otherwise. `deriveRecordFlowSurface` in `packages/spec/src/data/record-surface.ts`, read at the branch point `0b1179f33`: `deriveRecordSurface` answers `'page'` on a mobile viewport or at/above `RECORD_SURFACE_PAGE_THRESHOLD` (12) authorable fields, else `'drawer'` (L88–93); the `view` flow routes when that says `'page'` and overlays a drawer otherwise (L160–162); the task flows (`create` / `edit` / `child-*`) never route — a derived `'page'` becomes a **modal**, `size: 'full'` on mobile and `size: 'auto'` (the renderer's bounded lg/xl) on desktop, and a light record stays a drawer (L163–169; objectui#12521 letter B, landed as PR #23747). So the sentence was wrong for create/edit on every viewport, and "mobile always pages" held only for `view`.

The bullet now reads (5 lines, as before):

    - **Surface.** Derived from field count and viewport. A field-heavy record, or
      any on mobile, is viewed on a **page** and created/edited in a **modal**
      (bounded on desktop, full-screen on mobile); otherwise a **drawer**. To force
      it, set `navigation.mode` (`page` | `drawer` | `modal`) on the list view — or,
      for bespoke layout, assign a record `Page`.

Each clause against the derivation: "field-heavy record, or any on mobile" is `deriveRecordSurface` answering `'page'` (L89, L91); "viewed on a page" is the `view` branch's `'route'` (L161); "created/edited in a modal (bounded on desktop, full-screen on mobile)" is the task-flow branch (L166–168: `surface: 'modal'`, `size: opts.viewport === 'mobile' ? 'full' : 'auto'`); "otherwise a drawer" is the light record on desktop, which every flow overlays as a drawer (L92, L169).

Keys named, each checked where the sentence puts it: `navigation.mode` is `NavigationConfigSchema.mode` (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` L2355; the enum at L2308–2316 carries `page` / `drawer` / `modal` among its seven values, unchanged hint), mounted on the list view at L2859 (`ListViewSchema.navigation`); a record `Page` is unchanged from the old text. The old "(or object)" is dropped: the object schema declares no `navigation` key (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` — its edit-intent key is `editMode`, a different key; see Acceptance notes). `navigation.size`, `FormView.type` and `modalSize`, which the derivation's docblock (L150–152) also lists as overrides, are declared (L2376, L4313–4320, L4399) but not added here: `size` is already taught two bullets down under Overlay width, and the token budget below buys no new key.

Token payment at zero headroom, inside the file, by content deletion only (no re-wrap): the title parenthetical "(page vs drawer)" — the bullet now names three surfaces, so the two-way title was false as well as costly; "Don't set it." — the section's intro at L125–126 ("You do **not** author the surface…") and its closing rule of thumb at L160–162 both state it; the false "(or object)"; and "for a specific object" — the list view is the per-object placement. The bullet goes 364 → 363 bytes, the file 9091 → 9090.

Text only; no behaviour changes. One other file: `.changeset/23753-navigation-record-surface.md` (`@objectstack/skills` patch). The edited file ships: `packages/skills/package.json` `files[]` is `dist`, and `sync-catalog` copies `skills/**` into `dist/skills/**` byte for byte. Measured after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/skills build` under the shared verify lock (65 files across 10 skills copied, read back byte-identical): the new lead sentence is in `dist/skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md` (1 hit), the old title "Surface (page vs drawer)" is not (0 hits), the file's heading is (positive control, 1 hit), and `cmp` against the source answers identical.

## Acceptance notes

- Out-of-scope observations, noted and not filed (read-only inference, no public-door probe, no class a/b/c evidence): (1) the object schema declares `editMode` (`'modal' | 'page'`, `object.zod.ts` L2805; its TSDoc says objectui's `recordFormNavigation.ts` branches on it) — a per-object edit-surface intent that the derivation's docblock does not list among its sanctioned overrides and that this skill does not name; whether the skill should teach it is a wording question for the skill's owner, outside this card's one paragraph and its zero-headroom budget. Dedupe words: editMode object edit intent; navigation.md override keys; record-surface sanctioned overrides. (2) The bullet's `navigation.mode` hint lists 3 of the 7 declared modes (`split` / `popover` / `new_window` / `none` omitted) — pre-existing, unchanged. (3) `content/docs/releases/v12.mdx` L71 says "mobile always pages" — a release page is release-owned history and is never edited in a code PR; it described v12 as shipped.
- Nothing else under `skills/` states the old mapping: `git grep -n -i -E "full page|always pages|page vs drawer|field-heavy"` over `skills/` at `9fc1d4717` hits this bullet only.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** — `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md` 「Record Presentation」节的 Surface 要点(第 131–135 行,共 5 行)。原文说「字段多的对象,新建/编辑/详情都以整页打开;字段少的用抽屉;移动端一律整页」;现在改为「按字段数与视口推导:字段多的记录(或移动端的任何记录),查看走整页,新建/编辑走弹窗——桌面端有界、移动端全屏;其余用抽屉」。覆盖子句只保留 spec 真实声明的位置(`navigation.mode` 在列表视图上),删掉了「或对象上」这个并不存在的键位。文件行数不变(162 → 162),token 读数不变(2273/2273,余量 0,上限不动);另加一个 `@objectstack/skills` 的 patch changeset。

**为什么改** — 这份技能包随 `npx skills add` 发到客户项目,读者是写元数据的 AI。平台的实际推导(`deriveRecordFlowSurface`)只有「查看」会走整页;新建/编辑一律是弹窗,PR #23747 落地后桌面端弹窗有界、移动端全屏。原句让 AI 以为新建/编辑会整页跳转,与运行时不符,属于「已发布句子失真」。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** — 纯文本改动,不改任何代码与行为。token 棘轮在零余量下靶内付清(删掉标题括注、与前后文重复的「Don't set it.」、错误的「(or object)」、「for a specific object」),上限不动。回滚:revert 本 PR 即可,无数据与迁移影响。
